description: Component for monitoring filesystem directories for new files.

directory_path.label: Directory Path
directory_path.description: Path to the directory to monitor for new files

file_pattern.label: File Pattern
file_pattern.description: Regex pattern to match files (e.g., '.*\.csv$' for CSV files)

job_name.label: Job Name
job_name.description: Name of the job to trigger when files are detected

minimum_interval_seconds.label: Minimum Interval Seconds
minimum_interval_seconds.description: Minimum time (in seconds) between sensor evaluations

default_status.label: Default Status
default_status.description: Default status of the sensor (running or stopped)

partition_mode.label: Partition Mode
partition_mode.description: How the sensor surfaces detected files: 'run_config' (default — embed file metadata in run_config), 'static_partition' (yield RunRequest(partition_key=<from partition_key_template>) — use when the target asset has a static/dynamic partitions_def), or 'dynamic_partition' (also registers each key on the given DynamicPartitionsDefinition first).

partition_key_template.label: Partition Key Template
partition_key_template.description: Template for the partition key per detected file. Fields: {file_path}, {file_name}, {file_stem} (filename without extension). Default `{file_stem}` — e.g. `/tmp/approvals/t3.json` → `t3`.

dynamic_partitions_name.label: Dynamic Partitions Name
dynamic_partitions_name.description: Required when partition_mode='dynamic_partition'. Must match the downstream asset's `dynamic_partition_name:` field.

name: Filesystem Monitor
